resources.string: On: use a virtual display and forward rear touch, preventing system double-tap sleep. Used by both automation and the tile.
Off: use direct casting. The system handles touch and Back gestures; double-tap sleep may still occur.
Applies to the next cast. The current cast keeps its mode; stop it before casting again.
Per-app settings for incorrectly scaled content
Virtual casting is unavailable on this system. Direct casting remains available.
